title: Liar Acts Weird With Cop Then Thinks It's A Smart Idea To Run, Gets Hospitalized
description:
#cops #police #arrest

Please be advised that no one was injured or dead in the video. He seemed to be severely dehydrated after trying to outrun the cops and a majority of the video has been edited out to not show the suspect in that state. 

On January 2nd, 2023. An officer conducted a traffic stop on a vehicle with a broken tail light. When the officer pulled up to the driver, he immediately started acting weird and was not following instructions. The man had no driver's license but was operating the vehicle. As more time passed, the man started to say that he had diarrhea and needed to go to the bathroom urgently, he also claimed that he was deaf and could not hear properly. The officer did a background check on him and found that he a warrant for violating his probation, evading arrest and more. The officer tried to wait for backup to arrest him but due to how he was acting, the officer tried to arrest him on his own and that's when the suspect fled. This is footage of the events that followed.
